training.seed_policy: catalog initialization seeds 0/1/2; original Transolver launcher has no seed flag; no training/dataloader seeding claimed

resolved_scheduler.source: derived from planned split/batch; no loader constructed

objective.reduction: sum sample-wise flattened ratios per batch; no epsilon (original TestLoss(size_average=False))

evaluation.aggregation: sample arithmetic mean; report each local seed and mean/std; never best-test seed
evaluation.normalizer: original entry behavior; do not infer LinearNO metadata-first saved-normalizer loading

data.normalizer: output UnitTransformer fit train; decode before loss

compute.scope: one model forward call; not an NS rollout/Plasticity batch/epoch
compute.excluded: softmax, RMSNorm/LayerNorm, GELU/SiLU, bias, residual arithmetic, distance/sin/cos, memory/layout and other scalar ops

construction_method: actual unmodified Transolver Model on CPU
seed_scope: CPU initialization only; original task has no seed CLI
comparison_notes: native Transolver reference differs from LinearNO in operator and task defaults; transolver_matched is not automatic proof of identical loss/normalization/seeding
protocol_source: actual Transolver script+parser AST+entry; LinearNO profile data fields used only as task documentation

provenance.records_format: cdlno/experiment.py config.json fields plus loop_run_manifest fields; offline catalogue, not a checkpoint schema

selection_policy: predeclared local seeds0/1/2; final checkpoint; report each and mean/std; no test-best seed/checkpoint
optional_monitor: not enabled or changed by this inventory
